# PHASE 5 — Notifications Localization Report

## Files Audited
- `src/app/features/notifications/notifications.component.html`
- `src/app/features/notifications/notifications.component.ts`
- `src/app/features/notifications/notifications.component.scss`

## Files Modified
- NONE — notifications component was already fully localized in Phase 2

## Audit Finding
The notifications component was already localized during Phase 2 (layout/navigation localization pass). All UI text was already using `langService.t()` calls:

| UI Element | Translation Key Already Applied |
|---|---|
| h1 title | `notifications.title` |
| p subtitle | `notifications.page_subtitle` |
| Mark all read button | `notifications.mark_all` |
| Empty state p | `notifications.empty` |
| Time format: just now | `notifications.just_now` |
| Time format: minutes ago | `notifications.minutes_ago` |
| Time format: hours ago | `notifications.hours_ago` |

## RTL Audit: Already Handled
The `notifications.component.scss` already contains an explicit RTL rule:

```scss
:host-context([dir="rtl"]) .notif-item--unread {
  border-left: none;
  border-right: 3px solid var(--color-aegis-primary);
}
```

This correctly flips the unread indicator border from the LTR left-side to RTL right-side.

## Items Correctly NOT Translated
- `n.title`, `n.message` — notification payload data from backend
- `n.createdAt` — timestamp data
- `formatTime()` locale-formatted date fallback — data formatting
- Icon and color mappings — logical values, not UI text
